scope: FD001, the original Table 7 ablation subset; do not generalize PCGrad results to FD002-FD004
architecture: freshly initialized canonical HybridLSTMTCNPrognostic, 18 input features, 30 cycles, 115095 total parameters
single_task: same full architecture and three quantile heads, RUL-only summed pinball loss; risk head receives no gradient or AdamW decay and is not evaluated
split: saved FD001 80/20 engine split and saved preprocessing per seed; no refitting normalizers; held-out 20 engines unused for checkpoint selection
training_windows: all complete 30-cycle windows on training engines only, no padding for short training histories; labels capped RUL and raw RUL<=30
rul_loss: sum of mean pinball losses at 0.05,0.50,0.95, not their average
risk_loss: 0.5 * BCEWithLogitsLoss with original float32 N_negative/N_positive training-window weight
checkpoint_rule: final epoch 16 only; no early stopping or best-epoch selection
paired_controls: same initial state, training tensors, per-epoch permutation, batch sizes and CPU Torch RNG stream/dropout masks across arms within each seed
multitask_backward: both naive and PCGrad compute task gradients separately using the same wrapper; naive sums unmodified gradients, PCGrad projects only shared-trunk gradients before summing
pcgrad_projection: for two tasks project each original shared gradient against the other original shared gradient if dot<0; preserve unprojected task-specific head gradients; global clipping follows aggregation
reduction: sum, no additional averaging or loss rescaling
diagnostics: training loss, shared gradient conflicts/cosines/norms, clipping, step counts, permutations and RNG digests, initial and final state hashes, gradient witnesses, training duration
evaluation: only after all 15 final checkpoints are trained, use official FD001 last-window test inputs and ground truth; report capped RMSE, MAE, R2, NASA total/mean, summed pinball and raw-risk F1/AUC/AP/Brier for multi-task arms
statistics: per-seed values; means/sample SD; paired pcgrad-minus-naive and multitask-minus-single-task differences; all seeds retained, no model/seed selection or significance claims
compute: CPU float32, one intra-op and one inter-op thread per worker, up to three independent seed processes, deterministic algorithms, no mixed precision
compute_amendment_before_full_campaign: The small 256-window spine smoke established execution. Independent seeds may train in three CPU processes to reduce wall time; thread count and numerical protocol within each arm remain unchanged. No test outcomes were used for this scheduling choice
preservation: archive legacy runner/wrapper, never overwrite original benchmark checkpoints, old ablation model or old Table 7 automatically
legacy_comparison: new protocol differs from historical 15-feature scalar-head development ablation; old numbers are not paired controls
test_exposure: retrospective remediation with previous official-test results already seen; no claim of a pristine confirmatory test
